lots.what_it_is: Plain wide D-section yellow gold wedding band, catalogued by Gowans as 18K, 3.6g, size S approx. Inside stamp is deformed, worn and dirty and cannot be read.

The stamp cannot be read in the photos, so purity rests only on the catalogue line. If it turned out to be 9ct it would be worth about $150. Scored 6 rather than 7 for that risk.
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 1: wide plain D-section band, heavily scratched, no stones, no engraving seen. The first character might be a 1 or part of an 18, and the second a rounded 8 or a C, but it is not legible. No maker mark or second mark visible. A faint small scratch mark near the stamp is not a mark.
lots.condition: Worn, with heavy surface scratching all over, shape appears round and sound in the photos. No visible cracks or solder repairs, though the back of the shank is not shown clearly.
